brief.zh: 从 N(μ, σ²) 里抽一个 z，交给解码器画出来。抽样用输入里的噪声 ε。
brief.en: Draw a z from N(μ, σ²) and hand it to the decoder. Use the noise ε from the input to draw it.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="8-4"></level-ref>最后得到的元件，正好是「用 ε 抽样」。
hint.en: The part you got at the end of <level-ref to="8-4"></level-ref> is exactly "draw a sample using ε".

after.zh: 训练好以后，生成就是：抽一个随机的 z，交给解码器。每抽一次就是一张没见过的新图；μ、σ 决定新图大概长在哪一带。
after.en: Once trained, generating is just: draw a random z and hand it to the decoder. Each draw is a new picture never seen before; μ and σ decide roughly where the new pictures fall.

t.zh: 托盘里的「重参数化」：μ、σ、ε 进去，出来 μ + σ·ε。
t.en: The Reparameterization in the tray: μ, σ and ε go in, μ + σ·ε comes out.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：用输入的 μ、σ 和噪声 ε 抽一个 z，画出它的斑点。
t.en: Your task in this level: draw a z from the μ, σ and noise ε in the input, and draw its blob.
